sections.heading: What's coming up?
sections.intro: Join us for magical celebrations, from Santa's Grotto and festive craft mornings to seasonal workshops and special events held throughout the year. Whether you're meeting the ponies, making something enchanting to take home, celebrating a birthday or enjoying a social occasion, our events bring together ponies, creativity and fun.

sections.heading: Celebrate your child's special day with a Pony & Craft Party
sections.tagline: Ponies, creativity and outdoor adventures, all rolled into one unforgettable party
sections.body:
Bring together the magic of ponies and the fun of making something wonderful. Perfect for children who love animals, enjoy getting creative, or simply want a birthday celebration with a difference.

Our mixed parties combine special pony time with engaging arts and crafts activities, in a relaxed countryside setting five minutes' drive from the centre of Bath.

Children can meet and spend time with our ponies, enjoy age-appropriate pony activities and get hands-on with a choice of creative projects inspired by nature, animals and the great outdoors.

From designing and decorating to nature-inspired crafts and colourful creations, there's plenty to spark the imagination. Each child gets the chance to make something of their own and take home a little piece of the day.

Our parties offer a lovely balance of animal experiences, creativity and fresh-air fun, giving children the freedom to explore their interests.

sections.heading: Gift Vouchers
sections.body:
Give someone a little pony magic with a Creative Rein experience voucher. From festive adventures to memorable celebrations, there's something for everyone to enjoy, at any age.

Keep an eye on our upcoming events, or get in touch to ask about parties, experiences and gift vouchers.
